text: The authors explore two hypotheses: (1) critiquing a critique can be easier than producing the critique itself, extending the idea that verification is easier than generation to the critique domain, and (2) this difficulty relation holds recursively, so that when direct evaluation is infeasible, higher-order critiques (e.g., critique of critique of critique) offer a more tractable supervision pathway. They test this with Human-Human, Human-AI and AI-AI experiments and describe recursive critique as a promising approach for scalable oversight.
title: Recursive self-critiquing: critique of critique can be easier than critique, recursively
